page.layout: One page of running text in one column; a running head and page number above it; margin notes at the right edge, cropped by the scan and largely unreadable; a catchword at the lower right.

main_text.p: Montes gelu horridos, radiis Divinæ Miseri-cordiæ & virtutis Tuæ splendore solveris pe-nitus & colliquaveris, & vulgus hactenus de-lusum intellexerit nullos magis fortunis & conscientiis suis inimicos, quàm qui se vindices præcipuos & Patronos jactant eo tantum consilio ut in utrasque invadant, cave ne ullâ animi impotentiâ ultionem in eos mediteris, quos peccatum suum & stultitia satis castigabit.[illegible, ~6 letters]

Cum autem hanc Factionum & æmulantium invicem studiorum venenatam cuspidem eduxeris, omni Arte Regiâ & Clementiâ ad medicanda hæc vulnera incumbas eo temperamento adhibito ut non sit dolor remedii mor-bo æqualis.[?]
Ultro detuli Impunitatem & Amnestiam tàm amplam ut vel omnes complecteretur qui se Legi obnoxios dubitarent, & futuras suspiciones & metus excluderet.[illegible, ~5 letters]

Quem à Te etiam observari morem cupio, quoties hæc vel petunt homines vel sint parati accipere, ut eo modo largiaris, quo non mera necessitate aut Politicis rationibus expres-sa, sed à Christiana Charitate voluntario profecta videantur.

Nihil Mihi aliud jam superest nisi posse condonare etiam iis qui Me omnibus spoliârunt, atque hîc Dei gratiam agnosco, quod sim animo in hoc paratissimo, nec Me minus consolatur hæc Gratia, quam quæ unquam Deus dedit jucundissima, cùm sit Divini in Me

page.notes: The right margin holds small marginal notes cropped at the scan edge; only fragments are visible and they cannot be read, so they are marked as illegible at their approximate positions. The final "Me" is the catchword, not text. The long s has been written as plain s throughout. The mark after "æqualis." is doubtful.
